ROST has fat left tails. Excess kurtosis 3.4 means 99%-VaR understated by ~30% (normal: −4.2%; actual: −5.5%). Negative skew biases toward larger downside surprises (earnings misses, sector contagion days). Implication for sizing: real worst-case is 30-40% worse than normal-VaR suggests. Discount Kelly by another 15-20% to account for this.

Stop is tight relative to vol regime. 30d realized vol = 23%. Daily move ±1.5% (1σ). Stop is 1.65% away = roughly 1σ. P(touching either level within 30d): 77%. Of that, 42% chance stop fires first · 35% chance T1 fires first. Recommendation: widen stop to $208 (2.5%) to give thesis room. Reduces stop-hit probability to 28% while only changing R:R from 3.8 to 2.7.

In crisis regime · liquidity halves · spreads 6× wider. A 5% NAV exit ($25K) in normal regime = 1 minute / 5bp slippage. Same exit in crisis = could take 30+ minutes / 25-50bp slippage. Plan: at-size position requires planned multi-day exit, not single-day market order, if VIX > 30.

For long-only: accept the 63% market exposure as the price of upside participation.

CONVICTION SYNTHESIS · MEDIUM (5/10). Value (5y) bull + Risk (sizing) acceptable = the trade is structurally valid. Swing (1d–4w) bear + Earnings/Macro neutral = the trade is timing-vulnerable. ⚠ CONFLICT IS THE ASYMMETRY: Risk says you CAN size 3–5% safely; Value says you SHOULD eventually; Swing says NOT NOW. Resolution: defer entry until swing/value alignment (price to $197 OR quality compounding visible). Risk-budget remains intact regardless of timing.
